notes.title: 1.2.2: QOL & Balance
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/01b98aced4af826b868de9d774f6eb21be8af4a0.png
We've adjusted armor and robe stats to better distinguish their roles. Armors now align more closely with the heavy defense archetype, while robes provide greater additional stats. This change ensures that armors maintain their defensive identity without conflicting with the utility-focused nature of robes. Enjoy clearer choices and improved gameplay balance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/17aef1f56efaa9339b43d00019210572da7319a6.png
Introducing the Player Ignore! Mute specific players to avoid unwanted interactions and keep your gameplay focused. Hidden messages and interactions ensure a distraction-free experience. Adjust your ignore list anytime to suit your needs!

These unique badges will be displayed on your character, showcasing your prowess as long as you remain on the leaderboard. Compete for Weekly and Monthly badges, which provide timed glory but are removed if your character has been dead for a week or month, respectively. Seasonal Spirit Realm
The Spirit Realm has been given a new fall look!

notes.title: 1.2.0: Spirit's Awakening
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/6b1af8d89565db27aaeaa1d7d800d488b3a08458.png
New ways to play are on the way! Threads will define your character's ruleset, including how death affects you and the types of drops you can receive. We’re starting with 3 Threads, but look forward to introducing Event Threads soon—offering limited-time game modes for unique experiences!

Thread of Discovery - Beginner or practice

Use and receive up to **Rare** items (cannot use Epic, Ancestral, Mythic, or Exalted)
 Gain up to 1,000 Character Honor
 Keep items and blessings on death (a dedicated Thread end NPC has been added in order to cash in your character)
 No leaderboard


Thread of Fate - Current

 Use and receive all item rarities
 Lose and cash in all character progress on death
 Current leaderboard


Thread of Doom - PPE / Ironman

 Use and receive all item rarities
 No trading or receiving items from players
 Deposit only banking
 Lose and cash in all character progress on death
 Unique leaderboard


All current characters begin on the Thread of Fate. Additionally, any character created on a different Thread can switch to the Thread of Fate at any time by visiting an in-game NPC located in the Spirit Realm Temple.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/a0c2578c73d26da64e4255aa0358ccacaa3a7225.png
We’ve made a thematic change: Levels are now called Spirits, and experience is renamed to Essence. This new naming scheme reinforces the idea that you’ll be spending your collected Spirits instead of traditional Levels!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/e0dbc577ef26579394e39feb7dc7df374f07229f.png
A new guaranteed drop has been added to all bosses: Spirit Orbs! When used, these orbs instantly grant Essence, allowing you to quickly return to the fight after spending your Spirits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/2a11c01ce8b95021848a6483ddd337d5f568bc62.png
New ways to spend Spirits (Levels) are being introduced, starting with:

 Geridge: Upgrade equipment +1 tier (up to blacksteel)
 Yaga: +1 blessing slot


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/79f6de77d74bc7d66c88c4de7738c149e6527bd6.png
Bounty Posts have been removed, and their rewards have been integrated directly into the bosses. When you defeat a Realm Boss, the item rewards will now take your current inventory into account, aiming to provide an upgrade at the relevant level. The Quest system will return for Holiday events and NPC quests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/b9e71496c8a40e808b02f121b39287e206e41ad0.png
Bosses now require 3 nearby camps to be cleared before they can spawn. Additionally, the respawn timer still applies, but each camp kill shortens the remaining respawn time. To spawn a boss, you’ll need to meet both conditions: the respawn timer must have elapsed, and 3 camps must be defeated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/c7c52a97e47e33bb91a101301f0bcef8647b0f15.png
In each Realm, you’ll now find randomly positioned encounters in T1 and T2 areas! These challenging encounters, tailored to the biome, offer the best loot available. You can also earn new hats and unique drops from these bosses!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/7eee2ba8e1d0deef20a40150786d72c96d13d3bd.png
Select status effects have been divided into tiered buffs, with each offering 3 tiers of increasing strength:

 Speedy: +20/30/40 speed
 Empowered: +10/20/30% damage
 Fury: +10/20/30% rate of fire
 Armored: +10/20/30 defense
 Healing: +5/15/25 health per second


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/af14949bfb4c5b47df112236b7ae513171a99b43.png
Unique and high-tier items now grant Honor bonuses, giving you a percentage bonus upon character completion, whether through death or by visiting the Thread End NPC:

 Limited: +2%
 Rare: +2%
 Epic: +3%
 Ancestral: +3%
 Mythic: +5%
 Exalted: +7%
 20k Honor Items: +7%


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/c4ec9972885d3503d670c5114522d44d02777f17.png

 Wardrobe price change: 350 for uncommon, 1,000 for limited
 Reduced all class hp & vigor
 Reduced T3 & Overlord damage
 A Halloween event is coming this weekend!
 We will be watching the game and carefully listening to player feedback from this update. We plan to continue to tune balance over the coming weeks!

notes.title: 1.1: Rebirth
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/d783c6dde1964ba53036b56f5d5dcd855b52fda2.png
The damage of enemies and players has been completely overhauled, it is not worthwhile to compare values from 1.0 to 1.1 since all functions, enemies, items, etc. have received changes. The game in general is more challenging, but progression is much faster with higher drop rates and faster leveling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/34285b52306d90d318d1b038889d2563532be38a.png
We hope to give players a more accessible and immersive environment. As a result, settlements have been added to the T1 and T2 zones, allowing for fast travel to deeper parts of the map. Settlements might not have much to do in them right now, but they open the door for unique villager quests and rewards, so keep an eye out in the coming months for new settlement features!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/34a06666506e17cfd45d33e50531e42fe78fd571.png
The current system of spawning enemies can result in unpredictable and unfair situations around boss fights. To remedy this, we have added dedicated enemy spawns, hand-crafted boss arenas, and all-around stronger theming and cohesion. All 3 overworld maps including Hammurabi's Sanctum have been completely revamped, allowing for more engaging gameplay and environmental storytelling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/c9cb3e1ff516328a1479ee2af37c93ff1427fc97.png
Boss fights were often trivialized by large groups using stuns, roots, and slows. To maintain tank uniqueness and aid party efforts, a new Boss Armor system has been introduced. Now, attacks and abilities that apply stuns, slows, roots, and knockbacks will deal armor damage instead of interrupting the boss. This damage reduces a secondary bar below the boss's health, and once depleted, the boss will be left without armor for a period of time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/61d8d171183ce138e78584b77ee568d5407cfd03.png
The Bounty system is designed for both new players and Born Again veterans in mind. Bounties are short tasks that can be picked up via quest boards found throughout the world, and reward players with consistent standard-tier loot and quick level-ups.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/c99f976d678338134069e67e4fa3b7694f605cd4.png
Item abilities have received major changes, notably in cooldowns and damage. Cooldowns on weapon and ability items have been increased across the board. Agility abilities, however, have retained relatively lower cooldowns to fit the agility play-style. The cooldown increase allows us to give larger effects to abilities, namely in damage, durations, heals, etc. You will see large ability damages in 1.1, allowing for huge bursts of stored damage potential!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/3967209f0b945aeb9f416f4093e79164dde0127b.png
All items have been balanced and touched up, with some mythic and rare items receiving mini-reworks. Additionally items now have larger power gaps on item shape changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/1d193f8c354a9924147653f34473cf7f8d76845f.png
All classes have been rebalanced in 1.1 with an emphasis on letting classes lean into their styles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/c547aabe424355feba6b2c1cdd98021b040cbbc0.png
All stats have received changes, some minor, some large.
Strength - Now alters your damage output by a %, each strength point gives +1.5% output
Dexterity - Is now a literal Attacks Per Second value
Vigor - Is now a literal Health Per Second value
Speed - Tiles per second has been increased
Defense - Min damage threshold has been lowered to 25%

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/02cb059b0695d84980a7f37f7264bebd6f3403b2.png
You can now remove blessings at any time, at the cost of any charge on the blessing. Reseting has also been changed to now give +2 slots, +25 honor, you keep blessings and charges, and the only requirement is to be max level. We plan for this to encourage reseting and to keep forward momentum towards progressing a character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/2a39fbb4c00114371f4afd7e27af1c41c0f1f425.png
Drop rates have been updated so that you always gain more loot chances. After achieving    max rates, additional damage is then converted to excess loot chance at diminishing rates. The excess loot chance start heavily diminishing around +15%, but always increases.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/13836af178b5697d2037bff2ba97bc9a7ffc9d50.png
Max level has been reduced to 21, however, each level now gives more power compared to 1.0 levels. Leveling also occurs much faster in 1.1, especially at early levels. Each level gives you +1 honor and since more exp issuing given out, Honor gains rates are also increased. You'll roughly end up with +50 honor at level 21 and prices have been adjusted accordingly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/0285f46c151225e75671ff931a1f738778c9c57a.png
All enemy behavior have been touched up, redesigned, with the goal of increasing difficulty where necessary and bringing out the interesting behaviors of enemies. You'll notice larger base max health on T3 and T2 encounters, however, the health scaling per player has been reduced to +40% from +80%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/108a48a3541ff87fd1c91a95c8d5e9f143824e7b.png

 Dazed - Returned 50% control to player, dazed movement is 50% as effective
 Invulnerable - Fully disables hit detection (projectiles will phase through you)
 Healing - +15 hp/sec
 Empowered - +15% damage
 Armored - +10 & +50% defense
 Fury - +20% attacks per second
 Invisible - After 1 second, attacks reveal the player


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949498/931532f0f34a57ed7ad219baf622aced4030f49a.png
Encounters in the realm now all spawn on their own spawn zones. Meaning you can fight T3s simultaneously or constantly one after another, with lowered encounter respawn rates.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.5

Bug Fixes
- Adjusted class menu thread height on mobile
- Bank menu now closes while in trade
- Fixed low health modifier tooltip to show constant status effect
- Fixed missing options translations
- Fixed boomerang projectile ranges in tooltip
- Fixed other languages not fading when mobile chat is closed
- Fixed attack targeting for boomerang basic attacks (mythic bow)
- Fixed flat objects blocking names (rugs, etc)
- Fixed sword ability and jumping into collision
- Fixed ground projectiles appearing in air
- Fixed attacking mid-jump


Balance
- Slightly increased the amount of health given by amulets of health 40 - 80 -> 40 - 100
- Added invisibility to Bloodletter Dagger ability
- Increased damage of Attuned Blade, added speedy on ability use to help land multiple slashes
- Removed Gloop-Covered Tekko fire rate increase
- Increased attack damage of Hammurabi's Safeguard
- Decreased damage of Hammurabi's Safeguard Hammer throw (overall buff due to boomerang projectiles)
- Decreased attack damage of Umbra's Bow (overall buff if you hit all shots due to boomerang projectiles)
- Slightly reduced heal amount on consumables
- Dragon: Increased crit chance 10% - 30% -> 12% - 32%
- Toad: Increased heal 10 - 30 -> 12 - 32
- Snake: Decreased effects 1 s - 3s -> 0.8s - 2.8s
- Yak: Adjusted block chance 5% - 25% -> 10% -> 20%
- Fox: Reduced fury duration 3s - 5s -> 2.8s - 4.8s 
- Elephant: Adjusted effects 2s - 6s -> 2.5s - 5s
- Monkey: Adjusted cooldown 30% - 50% -> 25% - 50%
- Panda: Adjusted activation threshold 30% - 50% -> 25% - 50%
- Adjusted Blessing and Crystal drop tables (drop chance unchanged)
- Removed speed per level, increased character base speed
- Removed defense per level
- Adjusted Class balance (Agility classes should feel much better now)

Features
- Dazed effect mini-rework. Dazed now takes full player move control while allowing jump/move abilities
- Added hat previews to hat shop
- Player boomerang projectiles now hit twice, once out and once back
- Class honor prices adjusted to be the same for all classes, but increases with each unlock (medallion unlocks do not increase price)
- Travel map merged with main map. Travel to any coachman, anytime.
- Added double-click to equip
- Added double-click to store/take from bank
- Removed Unity Logo in splash screen
- Increased max bank rows to 30
- Added "Are you sure?" confirm for sending a player report
- Added resolution scale and light quality performance options
- Removed bomb/aoe particles when the sender's opacity is below 40%
- Updated shops to just show a tooltip with a purchase button (no bubbles)
- Tooltip background flair for Rare/Mythic/Exalted
- Boss invulnerable health bar skin
- Added new blessings:
 - Lion
 - Mantis
 - Hippo
 - Rabbit
 - Bull
 - Crab
